items.title: Electron: Mitigation for compromised eMudhra intermediate certificates
items.summary: ### Impact A set of eMudhra intermediate certificates were compromised and are being blocked by browsers and other TLS clients. This Electron update adds the same block to both Chromium networking and Node.js `tls`, `https` and `fetch`.
